CustomField.label: Cluster Key
CustomField.description: Coarse canonical address-cluster bucket key that co-locates fuzzy-equivalent addresses in a single lock partition (e.g. street number + first street-name token: '123 Main Street', '123 Main St' and '123 main street unit 4' all map to '123 main'). This is a COARSE lock partition, NOT the exact claim key - the exact/atomic dedup key is Property_Registry__c.Property_Key__c. Coarseness is intentional: it only affects lock contention, never correctness, and is what lets a FOR UPDATE lock on one row serialise all fuzzy variants of the same property.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Do not edit directly. Populated by the matching service from the normalized inbound property address as a coarse serialization bucket.
